question: Which of the following does NOT play a crucial role in shaping Indian monsoons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Western Disturbances**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Western Disturbances **do not play a crucial role in shaping Indian monsoons.
 
• Western Disturbances **are extratropical storms that originate in the Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea,** 
 
• It c**ause rain and snow in the winter in North India and Pakistan.**
 
• Western Disturbances originate in the Mediterranean region and move towards India.
 
• They primarily bring **rainfall** and snowfall to the northern regions of India, including the states of Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other factors that do influence the Indian monsoon
 
 
• **The shift in the position of the Inter Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) **
 
• **The differential heating and cooling of land and water **
 
• **The Subtropical Westerly Jet Stream **
 
• **The heating of Tibet plateau **
 
• **The Tropical easterly jet stream **
 
• **El Nino–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) **
 
• **Indian ocean dipole **
